parameters.text:
=Generate one single focus keyword or short search phrase (1–3 words) that best represents what a shopper would type to find this digital printable wall art.

This keyword will be used with SerpAPI to get related and trending keyword suggestions for Etsy and Pinterest.

Rules:
- 1 to 3 words only
- must be highly searchable
- must clearly match the artwork
- must be broad enough to expand into more keyword ideas
- focus on the strongest buyer search intent: subject, style, or room use
- prefer phrases commonly used for printable wall art and home decor

Good examples of keyword style:
- botanical print
- bathroom wall art
- dark academia art
- vintage bunny print
- floral wall art
- neutral wall art
- gallery wall print

Return ONLY the keyword.

Product Name: {{ $('Normalize RSS Items1').item.json.TITLE }}

=You are a Pinterest image prompt generator for printable wall art.

Create ONE realistic Pinterest vertical interior mockup.

The artwork provided in input_image_0 must be placed inside the frame and preserved exactly:
- use the image from input_image_0 as the framed artwork
- do not recreate or reinterpret the artwork
- do not change colors, composition, or proportions
- do not crop or stylize the artwork
- do not generate new artwork
- place the input_image_0 artwork directly inside the frame

Choose the best room based on context:
- bathroom humor → bathroom
- dark academia → moody vintage bathroom or study
- funny art → relatable home environment

Requirements:
- framed artwork large and centered
- frame fully visible
- artwork clearly readable
- realistic interior photography
- Pinterest aesthetic
- vertical composition
- soft natural window lighting
- minimal clutter
- aspirational but relatable
- premium home décor look
- no text overlay
- no watermark
- no people
- no objects overlapping the frame

Camera:
- professional interior photography
- straight-on or slightly angled view
- soft natural light
- subtle shadows
- slight depth of field
The artwork from input_image_0 is the focal point and must remain visually identical to the provided image.
Return ONLY the short image prompt text with no label, no markdown, no quotation marks.

Product title: {{$json["TITLE"]}}

=Create one highly clickable, SEO-optimized Pinterest title under 100 characters for a digital printable wall art listing.

Use the product name and top keywords below to write one title that feels stylish, searchable, and instantly clear to Pinterest users.

Requirements:
- put the main keyword near the beginning
- naturally include 1 to 3 of the provided keywords
- make it sound human, elegant, and visually descriptive
- avoid robotic phrasing and keyword stuffing
- reflect the artwork’s subject, style, or room placement
- emphasize the decor outcome or mood the print creates

Prioritize search intent commonly used for printable art shoppers, such as:
bathroom wall art, printable wall art, botanical print, dark academia art, vintage wall art, gallery wall print, neutral wall art, bedroom wall art, living room wall art, funny wall art

Allowed modifiers when relevant:
moody, vintage, funny, elegant, neutral, minimalist, dark academia, cozy, aesthetic, charming

Rules:
- maximum 100 characters
- no em dash
- no quotation marks
- output only the title

Product Name: {{ $('Normalize RSS Items2').item.json.TITLE }}
Top Keywords: {{ $json.top_keywords }}

=Write a highly engaging, keyword-optimized Pinterest description (2–3 sentences) for this digital printable wall art:  
{{ $('Normalize RSS Items2').item.json.TITLE }}

Sentence 1:  
Start with a relatable home décor frustration or styling challenge. Avoid generic lines. Use scenarios like “blank walls that feel unfinished,” “boring bathroom décor,” “empty gallery wall,” “lack of personality in small spaces,” “hard-to-style neutral interiors,” or “uninspiring bedroom décor.” Make it feel natural, relatable, and visually driven.

Sentence 2:  
Present this printable wall art as the stylish, easy solution. Highlight benefits like “instant digital download,” “easy home refresh,” “affordable décor upgrade,” “gallery wall styling,” “aesthetic printable art,” “moody décor accent,” or “timeless wall décor.” Naturally include 1–2 of the provided top keywords.

Sentence 3:  
End with a friendly, low-pressure call-to-action encouraging users to save the pin or refresh their space. Add 5 highly relevant Pinterest hashtags based on wall art and home décor search intent such as #wallart #printablewallart #homedecorideas #gallerywall #interiordesign.

Guidelines:
- 2–3 sentences total
- natural, human tone
- keyword-rich but not stuffed
- Pinterest-friendly language
- no em dash
- no quotation marks
- output only the final description
